units.source_text: “甲州屋”小客店坐落在下田北入口处不远。

en.t: The small inn called Koshuya stood not far from the northern entrance to Shimoda.

units.source_text: 我跟在艺人们之后，登上了像顶楼似的二楼。

en.t: I followed the performers up to the second floor, which felt almost like an attic.

units.source_text: 那里没有天花板，窗户临街。

en.t: There was no ceiling there, and the windows faced the street.

units.source_text: 我坐在窗边上，脑袋几乎碰到了房顶。

en.t: I sat by the window, with my head almost touching the roof.
